This game captures the ridiculous violent, grim dark universe of Warhammer 40k  pretty well! Mind you, this game is pretty old, so graphics are not state-of-the-art. 

I haven`t finished the single-player campaign yet. To me the multiplayer, especially the horde-mode, is the real gem here. It is pretty fun to mow throw countless waves of orcs and chaos space marines and that makes more than up for the graphics.

In any case: As this game costs less than 10 EUR, it`s more than worth it.

a fantastic action game that is a MUST for every fan of WH40k
though the melee combat in this game is simplistic, it makes up for it  with a fluid combination with ranged combat.
you always need to switch between your ranged and melee weapons. you always need to dodge and proiritize the more dangerous enemies, and there are plenty of fun gimicks like the assault jump packs and stationary plasma canons to keep the gameplay varried
and of course the graphics are fantastic even for a 8 year old game. 

sadly the multiplayer is dead and the singleplayer is about 5-6 hours long so less worth getting at full price

It's not an incredible masterpiece of an action game by any means and it drags a little near the end as you've pretty much seen everything the game is going to do before the last 2 hours, but it nails the 40k aesthetic and chopping through orks with a chainsword or power axe is a lot of fun, with just enough weapon and enemy variety to keep things interesting. Story is pretty standard for a piece of 40k media, no huge surprises, crazy characters, or new takes on the franchise here. Ork warboss is pretty entertaining though, wish he had more screen time. 

TLDR: Worth a play for 40k fans who wants the space marine power fantasy. Those not interested in the franchise will find a mediocre action game and not much beyond that.
